question:
I've installed DBT CLI on GCP cloud shell using pip install dbt after that I had added the path to dbt in my .profile file too -

.profile file -

if [ -d "$HOME/.local/bin" ] ; then

fi

export $PATH

title: How to install DBT CLI on GCP?
answer: Try pip install dbt-[adapter] (eg dbt-bigquery) which will install the latest version of dbt, rather than the pre-1.0 version you’re getting now (which has become broken due to an issue with a dependency).
